answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. A knoll of per-task receipts records who did what, and the umber of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the timber of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
